0049223.Actors: Walter Pidgeon, Anne Francis, Leslie Nielsen
0049223.Plot: A starship crew in the 23rd century goes to investigate the silence of a distant planet's colony, only to find just two survivors, a powerful robot, and the deadly secret of a lost civilization.

0049223.overview: Starship C57D travels to planet Altair 4 in search of the crew of spaceship "Bellerophon," a scientific expedition that has been missing for twenty years. They find themselves unwelcome by the expedition's lone survivor and warned of destruction by an invisible force if they don't turn back immediately.
0049223.tagline: Earthmen on a fabulous, peril-journey into outer space!
